Build R14 and R16 and all three work packages in docs/product/tdd/E09.md:9. This is a build plan for senior review, with planned evidence only. No product code or design is written here.

Existing contracts/ and config/ contain pharmacy assets. The root Python project is the engine team's project. Use the standalone hub environment required by docs/SYSTEM.md:1661; do not edit the root toolchain.

Ownership comes from docs/SYSTEM.md:74, :100, :137, :141 and :1625. The reports module owns reports_report references and reports_confirmation, encrypted report versions, hub/tests/reports/, its crew feature directory and eval/scenarios/E09/. Directory allocations below instantiate SYSTEM's module/layer/feature/test templates, not a missing design's section 13. No other inspected docs/build/*/tasks.json claims these roots. E12's tools/adapters/handlers/reports.py is a consumer and remains E12's. E01 owns records, private storage infrastructure and Jobs; E02 owns consent/vaults; E03 owns shell and configuration; E05 owns measurement requests/gaps; E15 owns RecordsView; E16/E29 own transport. Recheck plans before dispatch.

## Design decisions

- **Seams and private data.** Use SYSTEM sections 5.1 to 5.12 verbatim, particularly 5.8.1/D18 and 5.10.1/D17. All bytes, filenames, source hashes, dates, drafts and spans stay encrypted in private.sqlite. Hub tables contain opaque refs, grants, keyed fingerprints, task refs and clinical confirmation lineage only. Confirmation appends through E01 records in the caller's hub transaction; it never writes records_observation directly. E09 emits no new report event. Job progress is E01's event with a registered current-grant audience; a report result has null Job.result_ref when the evidence enum cannot represent it.
- **Media and parsing.** Support only PDF, PNG and JPEG, with the exact 20000000 byte upload bound in docs/tdd/E01.md:597 and docs/product/api/openapi.yaml:5063. Check actual media and decode integrity, not extension alone. Quarantine unsafe/corrupt inputs encrypted, with no extraction, inline execution or clinical use. Select bounded local text extraction into proposals, with human confirmation and no diagnostic image interpretation. PNG/JPEG and image-only PDFs use source review and manual structured entry when OCR is unavailable; never synthesize a draft. Parsing runs outside the hub writer under the E20 containment agreement P6. No remote parser or required LLM. The review UI shows source beside draft with patient, date, unit and attribution. Source viewing, manual entry and quarantine representation await P2/P3/P4, without removing their acceptance.
- **Time and concurrency.** Preserve date-only source dates as dates and unknowns as null; never invent midnight or a timezone to manufacture observed_at. Observation time mapping needs P2. Use SYSTEM 5.2/5.3 for time and clock correction; 5.10.1 leases are elapsed deadlines, not report dates. Pin source version, engine version and release per extraction. Refresh reuses its task identity. Compare the current report revision and source version for confirmation under the private barrier, using the agreed ETag P2. Delayed/cancelled/deleted/revoked generations cannot publish. Configuration activation never changes existing work's pins.
- **Failure and backup.** Primary extraction is a proposal, with independent human source review and structured entry as backup; fail safe is an unconfirmed report with an explicit reason and no accepted finding. Primary storage is the hub/private pair; backup is E01/E20's verified paired snapshot and current E02 vault, never an independent E09 recovery engine. Test every seal/reference/receipt/acknowledgment boundary, confirmation versus deletion, old-media restore, full disk, missing ciphertext and key loss. A storage/integrity error fails loudly. Confirmation, source review and entry work on the laptop with model, devices and ground absent. Hub loss leaves private edits visibly unsaved in owner-session memory; private content is never queued or cached in the browser.
- **Content and bounds.** Consume ui-copy.json, indicator-catalog.json and unit-mapping.json through SYSTEM 5.6, with no E09 ownership of them. Existing catalog examples have no complete specialist-form definitions. P3 must settle that content through its owners. Use SYSTEM 5.11 private.max_report_bytes, private.max_entry_bytes, private.max_versions, private.coordinator_timeout_ms, private.recovery_batch, commands.max_bytes, storage limits, tasks limits and workers.<name> resource/timeout descriptors. P6 supplies missing parser page/pixel/text/span bounds with provenance; no arbitrary default enters a brief or runtime. Reaching capacity refuses new work and never deletes accepted versions.

## End to end evidence

T5 places HTTP and browser tests and their explicit-profile inputs only in eval/scenarios/E09/. Use create_app(settings), real temporary hub.sqlite/private.sqlite and actual configuration, auth, consent, records, tasks, audit and vault providers. Seed through authenticated APIs or E21's agreed seed interface. No in-hub mocks, dependency overrides or SQL seeding. Optional workers may be absent or use documented external fakes. Use E21's launcher rather than a second launcher. Missing providers, fault controls or scenarios fail acceptance; no skip, xfail or empty collection is success.

| Proof | Required end to end assertions | Trace |
|---|---|---|
| Upload and recovery | Valid bounded PDF/PNG/JPEG retain identical source and metadata; malformed/unsafe/corrupt inputs quarantine. Kill at every D18 boundary, restart, retry same key before/after cache expiry, then retrieve one accepted report. Different body/target/parameters conflict. Disk failure yields no false acknowledgment. Paired restore preserves accepted entries and denies deleted keys. | R14; V16, V35; AGENTS durability |
| Human confirmation | Wrong patient/date/unit, missing identity acknowledgment, invalid spans, null/unknown times, nonfinite values and incompatible units create no accepted clinical fact. Correct through approved fields, explicitly confirm, then read the attributed finding and provenance through the real records API. Reject stays rejected. Two clients with one revision produce one accepted result; deletion/revocation wins against late work. | R14/R16; V14, V15, V21 |
| Specialist forms and source | Keyboard-only eye, ECG, laboratory, imaging and dosimetry forms preserve method/instrument, units, dates, source and separate clinician interpretation. Numeric and textual findings round-trip through their approved types. No webcam/image diagnosis and no pulse-derived ECG or personal radiation dose. | E09-03; R14/R16; V36, V38 |
| Extraction isolation | PDF instructions remain inert data. Stop parser/model, cancel Jobs, expire leases, change grants and delete source while extraction completes. No late draft or accepted fact appears; manual review/entry still works. Missing/corrupt pinned inputs fail rather than switching versions. | R14/R16; V21, V22, V69 |
| Privacy and sharing | Another crew member, officer without object grant, station, assistant and undelivered ground recipient cannot read report fields, source or Job. Revoke during work/read/replay. Canary bytes/names/hashes/drafts are absent from hub metadata, logs, generic Jobs, caches, events, sync and exports. An owner-approved snapshot positively reaches only its selected recipient/fields after delivery; raw source requires whole-file approval. | R14/R16; V25; AGENTS privacy; P5 |
| Content and degradation | Change an approved non-safety label in scratch configuration and observe new served/rendered content with identical code. Invalid activation keeps last good and existing pins. With model/devices/ground absent, upload, review and manual specialist capture/confirmation complete. No fallback data, no private persistence in client storage. | R14/R16; V69, V75; AGENTS configuration |

V21, V22 and V38 are E09's principal product scenarios (docs/product/VALIDATION.md:41, :42, :58). The other V rows above assign E09's contribution, not ownership of the full cross-epic scenario. The frozen demo has no dedicated report D assertion (docs/product/VALIDATION.md:153). R16 also contributes to D10/D11: T5 must run an actual E12/E13 assessment after those providers arrive and prove only confirmed supported records appear, never drafts/rejected readings. E21 retains full D10/D11 demo ownership. Missing optional consumers leave that integration proof outstanding without replacing them with mocks.

## Design deviations

There is no design or E09 design-review finding to settle. These are product-brief clarifications under binding shared rules, not edits to a frozen design.

| Brief/package point | Rule that wins | What to build |
|---|---|---|
| E09-01 immutable attachment store | SYSTEM 5.8.1; D4/D18 | Encrypted immutable versions and hub refs with paired acknowledgment, not plaintext content-addressed files or a local coordinator |
| E09-02 extraction workflow | SYSTEM 5.10.1; D17/D18 | Durable report_extraction Jobs, generation fencing and sealed completion; human-only clinical acceptance |
| Report scope and authorized reviewer, PRD 4.4 | SYSTEM 8.3; E02 3.5 | Owner private reads and explicitly approved recipient snapshots, not role-wide vault access |
| Confirmation API If-Match and corrections | CONTRACTS 1/5; SYSTEM 5.8/8.6 | Revision and identity/date correction must be contracted under P2; no unconditional confirm or invented date |
| E09-03 structured specialist findings | CONTRACTS 2; input-dictionary.csv:95 | Preserve textual findings and interpretation attribution through approved types P2/P3; never force text into numeric Observation |

## Verification and handoff

The planning checks validate JSON, five disjoint task allocations, source read paths, dependency order, ownership against all current epic task files and forbidden writing forms. Implementation commands in tasks.json use the documented uv/pnpm toolchains and generated import rules; they are obligations, not executed results. Full E09 acceptance requires every proof above, resolved requests, independent review, CI and AI-use attribution. No runtime gate, independent plan review or CI result is claimed by this planning run.
